notes.title: How the Map Editor Works in Crongdor
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25340016/581443e8a0d2b0e97d654b9151e6fc5e737ee04f.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25340016/2858b54b105b95899716c31013d5c55d1bf28914.png[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25340016/937d74ce145bf8bd85639062b50842484b10852d.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25340016/6ce6fbc8a13970a6627a8b4c663c175efb9efb59.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyone!

I wrote a blog post about how to use the map editor for Crongdor the Barbarian.

I also describe a bit of background about how the maps system was designed for the game.

I put the original post on our crongdor.com site - 
[url=http://crongdor.com/2016/06/19/how-the-map-editor-works-in-crongdor/]http://crongdor.com/2016/06/19/how-the-map-editor-works-in-crongdor/[/url]

We have forums open there too, so we can see how that works out. If the majority of people prefer to use Steam's internal discussions/posts we can look at that too.

If you make some maps it would be cool to try them - we can chat about the best way to share maps too.

Feedback appreciated! I can also take requests if there are things that you'd like to hear about in particular.

Anton
